lc_person: Son, Po-gi, also published as Sohn Pow-key; Yonsei professor of history and prehistory with a Berkeley PhD; author on early printing and archaeology.
item_person: Pow-key Sohn, historian and university teacher associated with Yonsei University, studying prehistory and the Joseon period; born 1922.

evidence.says: LC authorizes Son, Po-gi and explicitly records Sohn, Pow-key as a variant and earlier heading. Its 1982 book citation gives both Son Po-gi and Sohn Pow-key and identifies a Yonsei professor of history and prehistory. Notes for the 1986 and 1988 books state birth in 1922 and a Berkeley PhD. LC links VIAF 59096139, ISNI 0000000116515015 and Wikidata Q16083638.

The item is labeled Pow-key Sohn and lists historian and university teacher, Yonsei University, prehistory and Joseon as fields, and birth year 1922. P244 is n82251523; VIAF 59096139 and ISNI 0000000116515015 match LC. Its GND identifier is qualified with the name Son, Po-gi.
The author authority headed Son, Po-gi lists Sohn, Pow-key, Sohn, Pokee and Sohn, Powkey as aliases, independently confirming the name equivalence.

Bibliographic metadata attributes Social History of the Early Yi Dynasty 1392-1592: With Emphasis on the Functional Aspects of Governmental Structure to Po-gi Son, University of California, Berkeley, 1963. This matches the graph entry’s dissertation title, institution and year.

notes: The automatic name disagreement is a romanization and name-order difference explicitly resolved by LC variants. Although the LC heading has no date, its source notes support 1922, agreeing with Wikidata. LC was read through its official JSON representation because the HTML page was inaccessible.
